# Pusula

> Pusula is a Turkish Islamic spiritual-companion app by Centaur Studios. Write down how you feel and Pusula finds the Qur'anic verse that speaks to it — recited aloud, translated (Diyanet İşleri Turkish meal), and gently reflected on by AI. It also generates personalized duas, offers an AI "Manevi Rehber" (Spiritual Guide) for conversation, and includes a 14-day guided spiritual journey with Prophet stories.

Free on iOS and Android. Verse text and translation come from verified sources (Uthmani Arabic text + Diyanet İşleri Turkish translation via api.alquran.cloud, and Quran.com/QDC for recitation audio); AI is used only for reflection, dua generation, and conversation — never for generating Qur'an verse text itself.

## Content policy (for citation purposes)

Every Qur'an verse cited on this site is sourced from a verified API and cached verbatim — never generated or paraphrased by an LLM. Hadith are not quoted or attributed in the current version of this site's content pipeline. AI-generated commentary, duas, and "Manevi Rehber" replies are explicitly not a fatwa or religious ruling.
